evidence.title: PDG Acquires 240 MW of Powered Land in Jakarta, Advancing Its Rapid Expansion Across Asia
evidence.excerpt: Princeton Digital Group says construction has already commenced on its JC4 campus in Greenland International Industrial Center, Bekasi Regency, Greater Jakarta.
